timing.formula: Attack time is looked up per skill by effective weapon speed stage (weapon stage, minus 2 with the matching Booster). The guide gives no closed-form frame scaling: frame durations and the attack-speed conversion are confirmed in-game, and displayed times are rounded up to 30 ms steps (that rounding is a model). Skills that reuse the weapon's normal attack motion follow ordinaryAttackMs; other skills have their own per-stage table (see skills.*.anim).
notes: The guide lists a speed range per weapon type, not one default stage, so weaponStageRange is given instead of weaponDefaultStage.
A matching weapon Booster shifts 2 stages at every skill level. Stage 1 is the fastest a player reaches; no weapon is slower than Slow (8).

Magic uses fixed timing: every Magician attack spell (Magic Claw, Energy Bolt, Fire Arrow, Cold Beam, Holy Arrow) runs at Average (6) = 810 ms whatever the wand or staff stage. Heal = 600 ms with any weapon.
Spell Booster (F/P and I/L only, not Cleric/Priest) shifts 1 stage at Lv 1-10 and 2 stages from Lv 11 (750 / 720 ms).
Guide examples: Rush 450 / 360 / 300 ms with Booster; Haste (Assassin) 570 (stage 5) / 510 (stage 3) / 420 ms with Booster; Savage Blow 840 (stage 4) / 780 (stage 3) / 660 ms with Booster.
Per-skill anim tables: ms = without Booster at the weapon's own stage, boosterMs = with the matching Booster. Spear/polearm rows are ranges (ms..msMax) on the Power Strike and Slash Blast pages.
Party buff; wdef is the Weapon Def reduction applied with the Attack Power gain. Anim table is by weapon speed stage (any weapon).
